solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A fine fellow, Raymond, in a fight

parts.note: F is the standard abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads
F is an abbreviation for fellow, as in FRS
Ray is the short form of the name Raymond

explanation.surface: A decent chap called Raymond ends up caught in a brawl.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening 'A' is used as it stands, and 'a fight' at the end is the definition with 'in' as the link.
explanation.definitionFit: A public brawl or disturbance of the peace is the legal sense of the word.

clue.text: Like something left by meteor, not one of the stars

parts.note: like means as, in the comparing sense

indicators.note: not tells us to leave out the letter standing for one from the word before

parts.note: a meteor leaves a trail of light behind it
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Something resembling a meteor's wake, yet not quite a star itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things relating to or coming from the stars.

clue.text: Boxer's achievement — and the woman's importance

definitions.note: read as 'Boxer is', the definition plus a link

parts.note: a feat is a notable achievement
her is the possessive for 'the woman's'
weight means importance, as in carrying weight

explanation.surface: A fighter's triumph, and how much his woman counts for, are set side by side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boxer's' stands for 'Boxer is'; the boxer is the definition, a fighter in a light weight class.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer in one of the lighter weight divisions is named after this class.

clue.text: Minister going topless? It's something criminal!

indicators.note: going topless means the first letter of the word is removed, the top of a down entry

parts.note: a parson is a minister of the church

explanation.surface: A churchman stripping off? Surely that is against the law!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Topless' suggests a scandalous priest but simply drops the P of PARSON.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberately setting fire to property is a crime, so it is an example of something criminal.

clue.text: Believe in not being overdrawn?

definitions.meaning: to ... a story is to believe it
a bank account 'in ...' has money in it rather than being overdrawn; 'in' completes that phrase

explanation.surface: Does faith depend on having money left in the bank?
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means accept as true; as a noun, 'in credit' is the banking idiom for a positive balance.

clue.text: A lot of mud floor churned up — there's quite a few people

indicators.note: churned up says the letters are stirred into a new order
a lot of a word, though not all of it, means its last letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A muddy floor has been churned up by a big crowd tramping through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A lot of mud' gives MU, which joins FLOOR before 'churned up' rearranges the seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Enough people to fill a room is a sizeable gathering.

clue.text: Incense driver after smashing plates, etc

indicators.note: after smashing describes the letters of the two words once broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: An angry motorist goes on a crockery-smashing rampage.
explanation.definitionFit: A matching set of plates, dishes and bowls for the evening meal is sold under this name.

clue.text: Score only 50% in assessment of perfect vision

indicators.note: only 50% in means just the first half of that rating is used

parts.note: perfect eyesight is rated ...-... on the eye chart

explanation.surface: Someone gets a poor mark when tested for perfect eyesight.
explanation.walkthrough: 20/20 is the measure of normal vision on a Snellen chart.
explanation.definitionFit: A score is an old counting word for a group of this many.

clue.text: Unexpected tourist angle about new airport facility

indicators.note: about means the anagrammed letters go round the next piece
unexpected says the letters fall into a surprising new arrangement

explanation.surface: A traveller takes a surprising viewpoint on a new airport amenity.
explanation.definitionFit: Airports provide a waiting area for passengers changing planes without passing through immigration.

clue.text: Sailor, with ache around middle of hull, gets shipboard cover

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor

indicators.note: around means the ache word encloses the next letters

parts.note: pain is an ache

indicators.note: middle of takes the central letters of the word hull

explanation.surface: A seaman with a backache gets a covering for the deck.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy waterproof canvas sheet was used on ships to cover hatches and cargo.

clue.text: Looking pale when encountering bird

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
a hen is a female bird

explanation.surface: Someone turns white on coming face to face with a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means drained of colour, the grey-white of ash.

clue.text: Umpire, about to block service hitting net, gets to ponder

parts.note: ref is short for referee, an umpire

indicators.note: to block means this letter sits inside the tennis term, plugging it

parts.note: in tennis a let is a serve that clips the net and is replayed
C stands for circa, about

explanation.surface: A tennis umpire, faced with a serve that clipped the net, takes time to think.
explanation.definitionFit: To think deeply or consider at length is a common sense of the verb.

clue.text: Shout "Stop" — is last in race to freeze?

parts.note: to cry is to shout
to stall is to stop

indicators.note: last in picks the final letter of race

explanation.surface: Someone yells for a halt: is the back-marker about to seize up?
explanation.definitionFit: To solidify into a fixed form, as crystals do when a liquid sets.

clue.text: Prison critic?

definitions.meaning: one who slams things, attacking them harshly

explanation.surface: A jail reviewer?
explanation.definitionFit: It is slang for jail, and also, literally, a person who slams or harshly criticises.

clue.text: Run in country producing damage to ankle

indicators.note: in means this letter is placed within the country

parts.note: Spain is a European country
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A jog abroad ends with a twisted ankle.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrenching the ligaments of a joint, commonly the ankle, is this injury.

clue.text: College my clue represented

indicators.note: represented means the letters are presented again in a new order

explanation.surface: A setter points out that this clue stands for a college.
explanation.definitionFit: A school or college, after Aristotle's school at Athens.

clue.text: Come out on top, requiring clergyman to fill bucket

indicators.note: to fill means the clergyman goes inside the bucket

parts.note: a pail is a bucket
Rev, short for Reverend, is a clergyman

explanation.surface: Winning demands a vicar squeezed into a bucket.
explanation.definitionFit: To triumph or win through is the meaning of the verb.

clue.text: Rush, heading off for spicy dish

indicators.note: heading off says the front letter is removed

parts.note: to scurry is to rush

explanation.surface: Someone hurries off to grab a hot meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A dish of meat or vegetables in a spiced sauce, of South Asian origin.

clue.text: Vessel caught going over simple boat

indicators.note: going over means this letter sits above the next part in the down entry

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a raft is a basic boat of lashed logs

explanation.surface: A ship has been caught capsizing onto a raft.
explanation.definitionFit: Any boat or ship can be called a craft.

clue.text: Ready to debate distribution of mature vintage

indicators.note: distribution of says the letters are spread out and dealt again in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Handing round a well-aged wine gets everyone talking.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone quarrelsome is always keen to dispute a point.

clue.text: Character that may be associated with reserve?

definitions.meaning: a person's essential temperament or makeup

definitions.text: that may be associated with reserve?
definitions.meaning: a protected area for wildlife is called a ... reserve

explanation.surface: Is a person's temperament linked to being reserved?
explanation.definitionFit: It means innate disposition, and it is also the word paired with reserve for a wildlife sanctuary.

clue.text: Running water and heated water? That's about right

indicators.note: about means the vapour word goes round the next letter

parts.note: steam is water heated into vapour

explanation.surface: Flowing water and boiling water are compared, and judged roughly correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A brook or small river is flowing water.
